description: This script manages GitHub security advisories related to vulnerabilities. It parses command-line arguments, interacts with Git and GitHub API via 'gh' CLI, constructs advisory payloads, and updates advisories with vulnerability data including package info, version ranges, and CVSS vectors.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for running the script.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the process.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into an object.

methods.name: runGh
methods.description: Executes the 'gh' CLI command with given arguments and returns output.

methods.name: deriveRepoFromOrigin
methods.description: Determines the GitHub repository name from the remote origin URL.

methods.name: parseGhsaId
methods.description: Extracts and validates the GHSA identifier from input.

methods.name: writeTempJson
methods.description: Writes JSON data to a temporary file and returns the file path.
